messages:
Marta (PM): Quick sync — finalizing GA criteria for the new predictor pipeline (post-beta). Need signoff on SLA, docs, support, monitoring, pricing. TL;DR: SLA proposal attached, docs ~80% done, oncall rota needs +1, sales requested a short-term promo.

Eli (SRE): SLA: p95 120ms is fine, p99 for long-contexts may spike. Request: add an explicit fallback policy to a smaller/cheaper model when queue/backpressure > threshold. Also propose a 48h SLA grace for first-week launch incidents.

Jess (Docs): API spec + request/response examples are in. Missing: runbook, rollback steps, and a short debugging play for prompt regressions. I can draft runbook once SRE provides escalation steps.

Sanjay (Sales): Pricing ask from AE: short-term "launch discount" (10% for first 90 days) for early adopters, and a clear path to reserved pricing. Finance said yes if we cap to X customers. Need product + finance signoff.

Dana (Product Ops): Monitoring: require prompt-regression metric, token-cost per request, error-rate by model-version, and an end-to-end smoke test on deploy. Ops-bot can schedule nightly smoke runs against canary. Also we should define alert thresholds and paging policy.

Ops-bot: Smoke test scheduled nightly 02:30 UTC against canary cluster. Results will post to #eng-sre and to the rollout dashboard.

Marta (PM): HIPAA pilot question — can we carve out an SLA exception for Customer X (needs private deployment + stricter uptime commitments)?

Carla (Legal): We can do a scoped SLA exception but only with a signed addendum/DPA. No unilateral promises; legal needs the statement to be in the contract.

Eli (SRE): Oncall staffing: recommend +1 SRE on-call for the first 7 days of GA and a dedicated rotation for week-1 incidents. Also add a runbook section: "When p99 > SLA and errors > 1% -> scale/pin model + failover to fallback-model".

Jess (Docs): Pushed runbook draft to PR #421: https://git.repo/PR/421. It includes the playbook skeleton and the sample rollback command. Please review.

Eli (SRE): Smoke test snippet for debugging:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.inference/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"prompt":"ping","max_tokens":8}'
```

Marta (PM): Signoffs needed: SLA -> Product + SRE; Docs -> Product + SRE; Support -> SRE + CS; Monitoring -> SRE; Pricing -> Finance + Sales. Who will own the final checklist and gate the ship?

Sanjay (Sales): I'll own the pricing checklist (discount list, billing codes, comms).

Eli (SRE): I'll own the SRE checklist (runbooks, oncall slots, smoke tests, dashboards).

Jess (Docs): I'll finish docs and runbook reviews by EOD Thursday.

Marta (PM): Awesome. I'll assemble the final checklist and mark ship when all items green. Please add any outstanding items to the checklist thread. :thumbsup:
